question: Bell A rings every 18 minutes, bell B rings every 24 minutes and bell C rings every 30 minutes. They all ring together for the first time at 6:30 AM. Find the time at which the bells ring together for the third time.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ LCM(18, 24, 30) = 360 minutes = 6 hours

⇒ Bells meet every 6 hours

⇒ 1st = 6:30 AM, 2nd = 12:30 PM, 3rd = 6:30 PM

**∴ Answer = 6:30 PM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A = 18 min, B = 24 min, C = 30 min

Start time = 6:30 AM

**Formula:**

Common interval = LCM of given times

**Calculation:**

⇒ 18 = 2 × 3²

⇒ 24 = 2³ × 3

⇒ 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ LCM = 2³ × 3² × 5 = 360 minutes

⇒ 360 minutes = 6 hours

**Final Answer: 6:30 PM**

**Time Conversion:** 60 minutes = 1 hour

**Occurrence Pattern:** nth occurrence = Start time + (n−1)× interval
